svg.aria-label: Top: the expression of Lemma I.6 minimized over the admissible states with side label, as a function of z, with its value at the transition state and the bound g from the disk alone used below 1/10, and an inset magnifying the small turns. Bottom: the rate k(z), increasing, negative only below about 0.076; the three cases of the proof are cut at 1/10 and where cos z = 3/5
